ci-runner: integration smoke failed: tests/smoke/session-persistence -> intermittent timeouts (2/3 failures)

brian: saw the same locally, repro steps attached in the ticket. suspect race in session restore after cold start.

meera: we need a decision: quarantine the smoke test for this rollout to avoid blocking, or pause the deploy and debug now. change window ends in ~90m.

oliver: prefer quarantine for staging so we can validate other infra changes. don't quarantine in prod without SRE signoff.

alice: pushing a quick `[quarantine]` commit to tests/smoke/session-persistence to remove it from gating suites for this run. commit 4d6f0a1

ci-runner: tests passed after quarantine \u2705
security-scan passed \u2705

deploy-bot: pipeline succeeded after test quarantine. jobs status: build \u2713 / test \u2713 (with quarantine) / lint \u2713 / security-scan \u2713

deploy-bot: deploying canary 5% to staging from commit 4d6f0a1
canary-monitor: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/canaries/4987

diane: starting 20m canary watch. alert thresholds: 5xx>0.3% or p95 latency +30%

sre-bot: note: if canary fails we'll auto-roll back and pin image at commit a1b2c3d for safety.

meera: also created ticket INF-812 to track the session-persistence flake and to revert the quarantine once fixed.

alice: tagging the candidate: v2.4.0-rc.1

deploy-bot: change window acknowledged. will proceed to roll to 100% if canary is green after 20m :thumbsup:
